aggregateByKeepaData.description: Whether to aggregate KP data, including sales ranking, monthly sales, FBA fees and sizes, etc.

countryOrAreaCode.description: Off-site shipping country code, e.g. `CN`, `JP`, `KR`, `TW`, `HK`, `MO`, `SG`, `TH`, `VN`, `PH`, `MY`; cannot be specified at the same time as the postal code in the site, and the Indian site does not support it. Maximum length 1000.

deliveryZip.description: The postal code or city of the delivery address on the site, the maximum length is 1000. The default postal codes of each site: `10001` in the United States, `EC1A 1BB` in the United Kingdom, `10115` in Germany, `75001` in France, `00100` in Italy, `28001` in Spain, `100-0001` in Japan, and `110034` in India.
